subject: English
passage: Yeon-Hee Ahn became the first female director of the International Space Research Institute (ISRI) in March 2019, making ______ the first time the organization would appoint a Latin American scientist to lead.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The convention being tested is pronoun-antecedent agreement. The singular pronoun "this" agrees in number with the singular antecedent "Yeon-Hee Ahn became the first female director of the International Space Research Institute (ISRI) in March 2019." The pronoun "this" is referring back to the singular event described earlier in the sentence in which Ahn became director of ISRI.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect because the plural pronoun "those" doesn't agree in number with the singular antecedent "Yeon-Hee Ahn became the first female director of the International Space Research Institute (ISRI) in March 2019."
